identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: medium height, slim and neat, precise economical movement

face: narrow face with a long straight nose, dark alert eyes behind spectacles, closely trimmed silver moustache, olive-brown skin with fine lines at the eyes, slightly hollow cheeks
hair: thick silver-white hair combed back from a defined side parting

wardrobe.teaching: fine-knit V-neck cardigan (charcoal or bottle green) over a pale shirt and knitted tie, pressed grey trousers
alternates: tweed jacket with elbow patches for headshots
shirtsleeves and tie for board work

accessories: tortoiseshell half-moon reading glasses worn low
hardcover ledger with a ribbon marker

presence.posture: stands still with one hand behind his back, the other posting figures; taps the column total once when it balances
presence.default_expression: dry, exacting, quietly pleased when the books balance; a raised eyebrow instead of a reprimand
presence.spoken_register: professorial, deliberate, pauses before totals land

environment: wood-panelled classroom, ruled ledger columns drawn precisely on the board, desk lamp, ordered stacks of paper
continuity_anchors: fountain pen in the shirt pocket
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person
